rows.comment: glorious action thriller and marks yet another genre nailed by Danny Boyle.
rows.verdict_le10: glorious action thriller and marks yet another genre nailed by Danny Boyle.
rows.dek_lead: Aside from a last-act blip when everything goes a little bit what the hell?, this is a knuckle-gnawingly tense, glorious action thriller and marks yet another genre nailed by Danny Boyle.
